Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "390", "observation": "A high-pitched electronic tone plays continuously, accompanied by a brief, sharp impact sound at the beginning."}, {"id": "405", "observation": "A low-frequency hum and a high-pitched electronic whine are audible, with a brief, sharp, high-pitched electronic beep."}, {"id": "420", "observation": "A vehicle engine idles, followed by a loud explosion and a sustained, high-pitched electronic tone."}, {"id": "450", "observation": "A high-pitched electronic whine transitions into a deep, resonant hum, followed by a sudden, loud, metallic impact and a brief, high-frequency electronic tone."}, {"id": "465", "observation": "A high-pitched electronic whine, metallic scraping, and a deep, resonant roar are audible in the recording."}, {"id": "480", "observation": "A deep, resonant roar is followed by metallic clanking and a high-pitched whirring sound, suggesting a large mechanical or robotic entity in motion."}, {"id": "495", "observation": "The recording features a continuous, high-pitched electronic whine and a low-frequency rumble, characteristic of a large vehicle in motion."}, {"id": "510", "observation": "A dramatic orchestral score with sweeping strings, deep percussion, and a resonant metallic clang creates a tense, cinematic atmosphere."}]
